name: CSS Text Effects
summary: Library of 114 pure-CSS text effects with copyable code, live previews and AI prompts.
description: A library of 114 animated text effects built with pure CSS — aurora gradients, glitch, neon, typewriter reveals, split-flap boards, 3D extrusion, retro displays and material textures. Each effect page gives a live preview, self-contained HTML and CSS to copy (with --ink colour tokens and prefers-reduced-motion support), a guide to the techniques used, and an AI prompt to have a coding agent rebuild it. A generator produces custom text effects.
